27B dense, as the maker states it (counted from the released files: 26.09B). language model (no LM head) + 0.46B vision encoder + 255-way readout; source: counted from the checkpoint's safetensors, nace-ai/drex-max-v1@cac65e1, huggingface.co/nace-ai/drex-max-v1; read 9 November 2026

Nace.AI's released Drex Max weights (nace-ai/drex-max-v1 at cac65e1), the original Drex Max, a fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B that also reads images. It ran on our hardware through Nace's own loader (drex_max, from nace-ai/drex-decision-models at e206b27), which makes 16 of the 64 layers attend non-causally, behind our HTTP server (servers/drex_max_server.py). One request at a time, as for the other setups.

Latency: the time from sending one request to receiving its answer, measured from our computer, network and any retries within the request included. Request time: the time at least one request was in flight, over the requests whose answers were kept. It is not the run's elapsed time: it leaves out requests that failed and any pause before a run was resumed.
